name: isc-plugins
description: Claude plugins for the ISC Formula Student Racing Team: project management, sponsorship, marketing, and the team-wide workflows everybody installs.

plugins.name: isc-core
plugins.description: Team-wide workflows: onboarding new members, recording decisions with their reasoning, and producing handover packs so knowledge survives the annual board turnover. Every member installs this one.

plugins.name: isc-pm
plugins.description: Project management: recomputes the schedule from the dependency graph, triages who owes what, maintains the season roadmap, and writes the weekly board report.

plugins.name: isc-sponsorship
plugins.description: Sponsorship: prospect research, outreach drafting, proposals, pipeline review, and tracking what we owe the sponsors who signed.

plugins.name: isc-marketing
plugins.description: Brand and content: defines and enforces the team brand, drafts posts in the established formats, and plans the season around capture deadlines rather than publish dates.
